sections.heading: Additional Benefits With Your Senior Citizen Health Insurance Plan
sections.text: Health insurance plans with various benefits especially formulated to protect senior citizens from extensive medical bills:

sections.heading: Hospital Cash Tax:
sections.text:
Avail income tax benefit under Section 80D of the Income Tax Act.*
*On opting for a Senior Health Plan for your parents, you can avail Rs 25,000 per annum as a deduction against your taxes (provided you are not over 60 years). If you pay a premium for your parents who are senior citizens (age 60 or above), the maximum
health insurance benefit
for tax purposes is capped at Rs 50,000. As a taxpayer, you may, therefore, maximise tax benefit under Section 80D up to a total of Rs 75,000, if you are below 60 years of age and your parents are senior citizens. If you are above the age of 60 years and are paying a medical insurance premium for your parents, the maximum tax benefit under Section 80D is, then, Rs 1 lakh.

sections.heading: What are the sum insured options available under the Silver Health ?
sections.text:
Under Silver Health Plan A, you can choose a sum insured ranging from ₹50,000 to ₹5 lakhs. For Plan B, the sum insured can range between ₹3 lakhs and ₹10 lakhs.
What is the entry age for the Silver Health policy?
The plan is available to individuals or families with an age range of 46 to 80 years.

sections.heading: What is the eligibility age for buying Health Insurance for Senior Citizens?
sections.text: Bajaj General Insurance offers senior citizens' health insurance for individuals aged 60 years and above. The health policy for parents under this plan ensures they receive medical coverage tailored to their age-specific needs and health risks.

sections.heading: Are day care procedures covered in Health Insurance for Senior Citizens?
sections.text: Yes, Bajaj General Insurance includes a wide range of day care procedures under its health insurance for senior citizens. This ensures coverage even for treatments that don't require 24-hour hospitalisation, offering more value from the policy.
